purpose: Canonical truth map for Stafford Media, ShopiFixer, and Abando surfaces before UI patches.

staffordmedia.role: Parent company, credibility layer, and service wrapper.
staffordmedia.primary_goal: Route merchants into the correct revenue path without confusing ShopiFixer and Abando.

shopifixer.summary_surface_rule: Preview/summary only. Do not treat as the full conversion page.
shopifixer.onboarding_rule: Onboarding belongs after payment or explicit fix-intent, not as the default brief-audit result CTA.

abando.surface_rule: Do not blend Abando recovery into ShopiFixer fix onboarding. Verify live host and route before linking.

known_blockers.issue: Stripe checkout URL is still placeholder.
known_blockers.impact: Post-payment onboarding cannot be truthfully completed until payment path is live.

known_blockers.issue: App host/live route truth must be verified before StaffordMedia links to it.

patch_rules: Do not patch UI from assumptions.
Map existing route, CTA, and engine owner first.
ShopiFixer diagnose/fix flow and Abando recovery flow must remain distinct.
Generated reports are runtime output unless explicitly promoted.
